citation: PLACEHOLDER standing in for the International Brain Laboratory brain-wide map papers; to be replaced by claim sets extracted from the IBL corpus.

claims.text: How is a visual decision represented across the mouse brain during a standardised task?
Neuropixels recordings across the brain in mice performing the IBL standardised visual decision task, pooled across laboratories.
Task-related activity is distributed across most recorded brain regions rather than confined to a few.
Signals related to the chosen action are more widespread than signals related to the visual stimulus.
Decision-related computation in this task is brain-wide, with action signals dominating over sensory ones in most regions.
